import html from typing import List # Example template; replace with the actual one if different. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{heading}

Posted by: {poster}

{body}
{labels_html}
""" def create_forum_post(poster: str, heading: str, body: str, labels: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster : str Author name. heading : str Post title. body : str Main content of the post. labels : list[str] Tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized HTML of the forum post. """ # Escape user-provided content to prevent XSS escaped_poster = html.escape(poster, quote=True) escaped_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # preserve line breaks if needed # Build labels HTML escaped_labels = [f'{html.escape(label, quote=True)}' for label in labels] labels_html = ' '.join(escaped_labels) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster=escaped_poster, heading=escaped_heading, body=escaped_body, labels_html=labels_html )
